title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Woodcutter

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a woodcutter.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a poor woodcutter who worked in the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The woodcutter’s axe fell into the river while he was working.
scenes.image_prompt: woodcutter dropping axe into river cartoon

scenes.text: The spirit showed him golden and silver axes, but he refused them.
scenes.image_prompt: spirit showing golden and silver axe to woodcutter cartoon

scenes.text: The woodcutter accepted only his iron axe.
scenes.image_prompt: woodcutter happily holding iron axe cartoon

scenes.text: The spirit rewarded him for honesty. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: spirit rewarding woodcutter with axes cartoon

story: A woodcutter lost his axe in a river. When tested with gold and silver axes, he chose honesty. The spirit rewarded him. Vikram said honesty brings rewards, and Betal flew away.
